BIOLOGY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Plants.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Plants.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Plants.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Plants.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Genetics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Genetics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement in Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement in Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement in Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement in Animals.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.

13. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.

16. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

17. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

18. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

19. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

20. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Genetics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
